machine: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory
draft: BF16 DFlash2, six proposals, 7 target verification rows
protocol: One Metal process at a time. Narrow prefill 127x8 + 7. Wide prefill 512 + 511. Measurements concern the target row for the second generated token after token 332. Synchronizing diagnostic hooks are unsuitable for timing. Natural logits at positions 1 and 2 are bitwise identical to the previous uninstrumented-activation controls, all 248320 entries. The final verification step ran with the live DFlash2 drafter. Positions of later proposed tokens are causally masked on the measured row.
mixed_method: Each segment runs the real kernels at the requested geometry on all prompt tokens. Its input comes from the preceding segment at the residual-stream boundary. Each segment supplies its output and the complete KV or recurrent buffers of the mixer layers it computes. In the final request assemble all 40 post-prefill states before the ordinary 7-row verifier. Pure narrow and pure wide segmented controls exactly reproduce all 248320 second-position logits. The MoE segment includes post-attention RMSNorm, routing, routed experts, shared expert and residual. A mixer segment includes its input RMSNorm, ordinary attention or GDN, and the residual. Wide/narrow names denote prefill geometry only.
matched_inputs: Wide prefill probed once more, recording each residual boundary then replacing it with its natural narrow counterpart for all valid input positions. A local RMS includes operator arithmetic and, for recurrent/attention blocks, the effect of their own state across the prompt. The last layer is scored only at the final prompt position because the prefill paths can crop their output rows. RMS is over hidden features and reported prompt positions.
readout_method: For target verification row zero, project the difference in each residual update onto (head_Shift - head_Hand) * final RMSNorm weight divided by the wide final RMS denominator. The identical embedding cancels. Add the reported narrow-to-wide final RMS denominator correction. Contributions telescope to the observed margin change within 0.000005 logits. These direct readout terms include propagated differences; they are not isolated prefill interventions.
cache_method: On a natural wide prefill substitute the saved narrow KV storage, recurrent GDN state plus convolution history, or both, immediately before the first verifier batch. Replacing both reproduces every narrow second-position logit with the wide drafter proposals.
prefix_method: For each boundary, the true wide prefill supplies all 1023 residual vectors at that boundary. Use the narrow kernels for all following operations, letting them compute their own state, and restore only the prefill caches for already-wide mixers before the ordinary 7-row verifier. Each margin uses a fresh uncached prompt and the same initial output token. Consecutive differences telescope to the natural margin change; this decomposition depends on the input-to-output order of switching. The final two boundaries return the same full logit vector as the pure wide pass.
